# A EUR rate in CAD whose source is a word GnuCash does not define.
#
# GnuCash would store it as `invalid`, silently, so it is refused.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the refusal, quoting the source.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_prices_source_and_type_are_kept_as_gnucash_wrote_them.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "EUR"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.51"
	source: "my-spreadsheet"
	type: "last"
